github.description: GitHub MCP server — gives Copilot read/write access to issues, PRs, branches, and repo contents

azure.description: Azure MCP server — Copilot can query Azure resources, Key Vault, and Resource Manager

filesystem.description: Filesystem MCP — Copilot can read/write local files in the workspace

_comment: To enable: VS Code → Settings → GitHub Copilot → MCP Servers. Authenticate GitHub and Azure before running prompts.
